parameters.content:
## Upload to Supabase Storage
Webhook → HTTP Request (Supabase Storage) → Postgres → Response

nodes.name: Upload to Supabase Storage
nodes.notes: SUBE ARCHIVO A SUPABASE STORAGE VIA HTTP REQUEST

parameters.query: =INSERT INTO document_versions (document_id, tenant_id, version_number, file_url, file_size, storage_provider, storage_path, metadata) VALUES ('{{ $('Extract Metadata').item.json.documentId }}', '{{ $('Extract Metadata').item.json.tenantId }}', (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_number), 0) + 1 FROM document_versions WHERE document_id = '{{ $('Extract Metadata').item.json.documentId }}'), '{{ $('Extract Metadata').item.json.publicUrl }}', 0, 'supabase', '{{ $('Extract Metadata').item.json.storagePath }}', '{"uploadedVia": "n8n-supabase"}') RETURNING id, version_number;
